output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

commands_run: cargo test -q -p xtask --test policy 2>&1; ls crates/athena-cli/tests/mirrors.rs
cargo test -q --locked --no-fail-fast -p athena-cli -p xtask -p athena-data -p athena-gate -p athena-context 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -q --locked --no-fail-fast -p athena-core -p athena-agent -p athena-score -p athena-git -p athena-testkit -p athena-cap-change -p athena-cap-study 2>&1
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -q --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test -q -p xtask --test policy 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git log --oneline | head -3 && wc -l crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs crates/athena-core/src/status.rs crates/athena-core/src/code_health.rs crates/athena-data/src/records/throughput.rs docs/design/hestia.md && sed -n 1,260p crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs
